name: Sabbath
overview: Scripture reveals that the Sabbath is a divinely instituted day of rest, established by God after His creation work was completed, as seen in Genesis 2:2-3 where God rested and sanctified the seventh day. The provision for preparation on the sixth day, exemplified in Exodus 16:5, 22-24, underscores the importance of honoring the Sabbath by resting and refraining from labor, with God commanding the Israelites to prepare beforehand so that the Sabbath remains a holy day of rest. These passages highlight the Sabbath as a sacred time set apart by God for rest and worship, emphasizing obedience to His instructions regarding its observance.
